purpose: Search for a replacement for portfolio direction 04 after the committed LO2v2 fail-closed disposition, without downloading or opening an artifact, changing the effective catalog, lowering the source-native grouping threshold, or re-promoting a previously held, rejected, advanced, or disposed candidate.

search_contract.accepted_group_boundary: A curator-declared source-native execution, workflow run, connection session, job, trial, or capture identifier whose identity does not depend on class, attack, technique, verdict, status, conclusion, directory, row, host, sensor view, date window, configuration, or an analyst-created grouping.
search_contract.explicit_count_rule: The curator or an immutable official record must state an exact count or an explicit lower bound of at least four accepted source-native groups. Artifact bytes, table rows, file count, plural wording, the word large, and collection-pipeline capability cannot substitute for that declaration.
forbidden_repromotion: every candidate previously rejected or disposed

strongest_new_direction.reason_not_advanced: The curator defines a valid source-native workflow-run identity and says that runs.parquet has one row per workflow run, but neither the inspected Zenodo record nor the pinned curator README states an exact workflow-run count or an explicit lower bound of at least four. The search contract forbids deriving the threshold from row count, artifact size, plural wording, or the phrase large dataset.

portfolio_distinctness.gharuns_surface: workflow run, job, and step execution metadata
portfolio_distinctness.logchunks_surface: captured CI build or job logs
portfolio_distinctness.reason: Different platforms and artifact surfaces are promising, but both directions are CI/CD execution evidence. A later review would have to prove curator, repository, execution, and nuisance independence and explain the scientific increment over the existing LogChunks direction.

unclosed_gates: Exact curator-declared workflow-run count or explicit lower bound of at least four.
Immutable source-native run manifest and duplicate, retry, cancelled, partial, and rerun policy.
Physical isolation of status, conclusion, job and step outcomes, actor identity, repository identity, branch, commit, pull request, and URL fields.
Dataset-level nested notice and field-level privacy policy.
Pointer round trip to an admissible source surface without exposing protected identifiers.
Train, development, and test overlap audit by whole workflow run and repository.
Scientific and nuisance distinctness from the already advanced LogChunks CI/CD direction.
Peer-reviewed paper identity and publication-to-artifact binding.

screened_not_advanced.title: GHALogs: Large-Scale Dataset of GitHub Actions Runs
screened_not_advanced.publication_venue: 2025 IEEE/ACM 22nd International Conference on Mining Software Repositories
screened_not_advanced.reason: The publication identity is verifiable and the title describes GitHub Actions runs, but this search did not close an immutable artifact record, artifact-scoped license, exact bytes, checksum, or a curator-stated source-native run count. It also shares the same broad CI/CD modality as LogChunks and GHARuns.

screened_not_advanced.title: A dataset of GitHub Actions workflow histories
screened_not_advanced.reason: The declared millions-scale unit is workflow files or workflow histories and configurations, not source-native workflow executions. Configuration and version-history counts cannot fill an executed-evidence direction.

screened_not_advanced.title: GADFPD
screened_not_advanced.reason: The public identity describes workflow records organized for failure prediction and classified by outcome. Outcome-bearing analytical rows do not establish a physically isolated, label-independent endpoint or provenance execution family.
The curator describes 400 random-seed scheduling instances. Synthetic optimization instances are configurations or problem inputs, not executed endpoint or provenance evidence.

verdict.reason: No newly reviewed family closed both the explicit at-least-four source-native group declaration and the immutable identity, rights, and distinct-family metadata boundary. GHARuns remains promising but held rather than promoted.

next_action: Keep direction 04 vacant. GHARuns may be reconsidered only if a curator or immutable official record publishes an exact workflow-run count or explicit lower bound of at least four and a separate authorization is granted for a family-level metadata candidate review that addresses CI/CD portfolio distinctness. GHALogs requires its own immutable artifact, rights, checksum, run-count, and distinctness closure before any advancement.
